_readme: Known events in the synthetic seed data, used by the eval script. Each event lists evidence: a seed file plus a text snippet that identifies the message(s). A detected event matches a known event if its supporting messages overlap the evidence messages. Traps are messages that look relevant but are NOT notifiable; flagging one is a false positive. awarenessDate is the earliest date the contractor arguably became aware (Irish local date).
